title: Mollification preserves the variation bound on the subcube Q_δ (Simon Ch. 2, 2.5; parent step 5)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, Q₁ := {y : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} ⊆ Euclid (m + 1), Q_δ := {y : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i}, u integrable on Q₁ and V ∈ ℝ with ∫_{Q₁} u·div g ≤ V for every C^∞ g : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ Q₁ and |g| ≤ 1 (hypothesis (H)). Let δ > 0 and let η be C^∞ with compact support, η ≥ 0, η(−z) = η(z), ∫η = 1 and support η ⊆ B(0, δ). Then u_η := η∗(1_{Q₁}u) is C^∞ and ∫_{Q_δ} ‖Du_η(x)‖ dx ≤ V.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (V δ : ℝ) (η : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V) → 0 < δ → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η → HasCompactSupport η → (∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) → (∀ z, η (-z) = η z) → ∫ z, η z = 1 → support η ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) δ → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (convolution η (Set.indicator {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} u) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) ∧ ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ (convolution η (Set.indicator {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} u) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x‖ ≤ V
